result.brief: 将预训练视频生成模型改造为统一的几何估计框架，以"预测下一帧"方式联合建模图像与几何目标，实现数据高效的零样本深度与法向估计。
result.reason: Repurposes pretrained video generative models as unified geometry learners via next-frame prediction, adapting video model priors and joint image-geometry latent modeling—directly relevant to video world models and generative latent spaces.
